buyers_guide.q: Why a smart smoke detector on a hub?
buyers_guide.a: Your hub can alert your phone, flash lights, unlock doors, or shut off HVAC when the alarm sounds, even when nobody is home.

buyers_guide.q: Do they replace hardwired interconnected alarms?
buyers_guide.a: Battery smart alarms add alerts, but if your home has hardwired interconnected alarms, code may require keeping them. Some smart models are hardwired replacements.
Combination alarms detect both, which saves ceiling space. Install CO alarms near bedrooms and on every level.
